newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light trade this afternoon with business mainly confined to covering of nearby needs, market sources said.

"A high dollar and with rain in Spain reducing fears of drought in Southern Europe dealers mostly bought some nearby material on calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening," market sources said.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $141 and $142 from two vessels and March shipment also traded at $142 a tonne cif Rotterdam.

Afloat cornglutenfeed pellets trraded at $142.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam and May/Sept Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $286.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam, down $3.50 from yesterday.--KAREL LUIMES + 31 20 504 5832
